title: Selected Topics in German Literature; Of Monsters and Men: German Romanticism
description:
Cross-listed with: GERM689Q. Credit only granted for: GERM439M or GERM689Q.

This seminar critically examines the multifaceted and fraught nature of German Romanticism with a specific focus on Gothic themes of the uncanny, irrational, and grotesque--among others--manifested in visual and literary culture around 1800. Taught in German.
